provenance.prompt:
Create a transparent-background orthographic pixel-art atlas for the single Iron Stations platform edge segment in the attached reference sheet. Match the source Pocket Dungeon pixel-art palette, outlines, gray concrete, bright yellow tactile tiles, dark steel and wood. The original map icon is a hybrid layout reference, not a camera instruction. Exactly six columns, one row: FRONT, TOP, RIGHT, LEFT, BOTTOM, REAR. One same physical horizontal platform segment in every cell, centered, isolated, generous transparent space, no labels, no perspective, no isometric camera, no tilt, no cell bleed.

The ACCEPTED TOP reference is authoritative for the plan footprint and position of the gray deck, yellow tactile strip and dark rail/support elements. Preserve that arrangement in TOP. The ACCEPTED BOTTOM reference guides the inferred underside only. The platform is a long, low horizontal structure: its long axis is world X; its short/depth axis is world Y; its thickness is a small fraction of either plan dimension. Its total width in FRONT/REAR must match TOP X length; RIGHT/LEFT width must match TOP Y depth. All four horizontal elevations have the same low concrete slab thickness and support height.

FRONT and REAR: strict end elevation across the long X span; show a thin horizontal concrete side edge, dark continuous rail/support profile and timber support blocks. Do not show the broad gray deck plane, yellow raised dots or full map layout on the vertical face. TOP should be visible only as a very thin top rim.

RIGHT and LEFT: strict end-on view along the long rail axis; a compact orthographic profile across the short Y depth, consisting of a gray concrete cap/block, thin dark rail edge and dark/timber underside support, all low and horizontal. Do NOT draw narrow tall yellow-faced posts, vertical columns, or upright tactile panels. The rail/profile must remain horizontal, not upright.

BOTTOM: physical underside looking straight up, opaque coherent support footprint matching the TOP XY outline, with the dark steel/wood backing and support blocks; no yellow tactile bumps visible from below. Keep exact object identity, no additional track pieces or separate objects. Pixel-art clusters crisp and source-faithful.
